), son of Wingate MOSLEY and his wife, Nancy.
married John Chappelle and William James Whiteman
married William Russell Wilson and Norman Benston Fraim
Charles H. Mosley died from typhoid fever on 19 October,
. His daughter, Sarah Catherine followed on 21 October and her husband on 23 November.

Annie continued to live in Cheswold after her husbands death. She was one of C.A.Weslager's informants when he wrote  Delaware's Forgotten Folk . She spoke of her mother, Catherine Morgan Dean, as being the daughter of John Morgan and a white woman (name unknown).

" Annie E. Mosley, Cheswold, DE who was well known in this 		area died Thursday at the age of 93 at the home of her daughter-in-law, 	Mrs. Mae Mosley. Mrs. Mosley was known by her worldwide circle of 	relatives and friends as "Aunt Annie". She is 	survived by four 	children: Mrs. Pearl Chapelle, Philadelphia, Mrs. Beulah Smith, Wayne, 	PA., Mrs. Mary Reed, Dover, DE, Mrs. Jeanette 	Wilson, Cheswold. 	Funeral services will be held Sunday afternoon at 1 o'clock at the 	Manship Manuel Church in Cheswold. Friends may call Saturday evening at 	the Torbert Funeral Home, State and Bradford Sts., Dover."
